nodes.label: Potato and Buttermilk Economy
nodes.evidence_status: Daily consumption, Lumper yield, skib use, meal months, and nutritional paradox are fact-checked as verified.
nodes.rationale: A nutritionally effective but monotonous potato-and-buttermilk diet sustained rural labour while extreme monocrop reliance made households structurally vulnerable.

nodes.label: Meal Months Hunger Gap
nodes.rationale: July and early August exposed an annual gap between exhausted old potatoes and the new harvest, shifting behaviour toward oatmeal, forage, charity, and hunger.

nodes.label: Food as Class and Social Signal
nodes.rationale: Tea, butter, meat, poitín, feast provision, and the choice of drinking house reveal class, hospitality, and affiliation.
